notablePrerequisites: Astral Cornucopia has at least four charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Gretchen by tapping {2}{G}{U}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat.
